newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Alberta gas hits 310 contracts on debut day.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Alberta gas hits 310 contracts on debut day.

text.p: Trade in the New York Mercantile Exchange's new Alberta natural gas futures hit 310 contracts on its first day, the exchange said.
The front-month November contract traded at $0.990 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) on the opening bell at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT and settled at the same price at the 1510 EDT/1910 close.
It resumes trade on Monday, with its first ACCESS session opening that evening.
ACCESS, the exchange's after-hours electronic system, will trade the Alberta gas contract for three hours beginning at 1600 EDT/2000 GMT, Monday through Thursday.

The Alberta contract specifies delivery at several designated interconnects along the Nova Gas Transmission pipeline system in Alberta, Canada, the exchange's first foreign delivery points for any of its energy contracts.
